```yaml
name: Devx Tag Automation

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  devx_tag:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Configure Git
        run: |
          git config user.name "github-actions[bot]"
          git config user.email "41898282+github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com"

      - name: Get latest release tag
        id: latest_release
        uses: actions/github-script@v6
        with:
          script: |
            const releases = await github.repos.listReleases({
              owner: context.repo.owner,
              repo: context.repo.repo,
              per_page: 1
            });
            if (releases.data.length === 0) {
              core.setOutput('tag', '');
            } else {
              core.setOutput('tag', releases.data[0].tag_name);
            }

      - name: Compute next dev tag
        id: dev_tag
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          release_tag="${{ steps.latest_release.outputs.tag }}"
          if [ -z "$release_tag" ]; then
            echo "No releases found. Skipping dev tag creation."
            echo "dev_tag=" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
            exit 0
          fi
          # Find existing tags matching release_tag.dev*
          existing_tags=$(git tag -l "${release_tag}.dev*" | sort -V)
          if [ -z "$existing_tags" ]; then
            next_num=1
          else
            last_tag=$(echo "$existing_tags" | tail -n1)
            last_num=${last_tag#*.dev}
            next_num=$((last_num + 1))
          fi
          new_tag="${release_tag}.dev${next_num}"
          echo "dev_tag=$new_tag" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          echo "release_tag=$release_tag" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT

      - name: Create and push dev tag
        if: steps.dev_tag.outputs.dev_tag != ''
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          new_tag="${{ steps.dev_tag.outputs.dev_tag }}"
          release_tag="${{ steps.dev_tag.outputs.release_tag }}"
          # Retry loop to avoid tag collisions
          for i in {1..5}; do
            if git rev-parse "$new_tag" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
              echo "Tag $new_tag already exists locally. Incrementing."
              new_num=$(( ${new_tag##*.dev} + 1 ))
              new_tag="${release_tag}.dev${new_num}"
              continue
            fi
            git tag "$new_tag"
            git push origin "$new_tag" --force
            echo "Tag $new_tag created and pushed."
            exit 0
          done
          echo "Failed to create a unique tag after retries."
          exit 1

      - name: No-op when no releases
        if: steps.latest_release.outputs.tag == ''
        run: echo "No releases found. Skipping dev tag creation."
```
